description:
Edit the Slide Master of the open presentation ('board_meeting.pptx') to add persistent branding. 

1. Enter Master Slide view (View > Master Slide).
2. Add a blue rectangle shape at the top of the master slide to serve as a header bar.
3. Add a text box on the master slide with the text 'Community Health Alliance'.
4. Close Master View.
5. Save the presentation as an ODP file to '/home/ga/Documents/Presentations/board_meeting_branded.odp'.

Ensure the branding appears on all 4 slides and the original content is preserved.
